All items require human review before any conclusion is drawn.

response_json.draft_memo:
DRAFT FOR HUMAN REVIEW — NOT AN APPROVAL

Subject: PO/invoice mismatch review notes

The deterministic review identified 9 flagged findings across 18 purchase order rows and 66 AP invoice rows. These notes summarize the exceptions only and do not determine whether any invoice is proper.

High-severity exceptions: invoice_exceeds_po for ap_invoice_detail:59 and purchase_orders:1; wrong_vendor for ap_invoice_detail:60 and purchase_orders:2; missing_po for ap_invoice_detail:61.

Medium-severity exceptions: missing_po_over_threshold for ap_invoice_detail:52; closed_po_usage for ap_invoice_detail:62 and purchase_orders:4; unit_price_mismatch for ap_invoice_detail:63 and purchase_orders:5; quantity_mismatch for ap_invoice_detail:64 and purchase_orders:7; invoiced_not_received for purchase_orders:10 and ap_invoice_detail:65.

Low-severity exception: received_not_invoiced for purchase_orders:9, which may be an accrual candidate.

Suggested human follow-up steps include confirming receipt with the department, confirming vendor and PO issuance details with procurement, verifying whether referenced POs exist or were omitted, confirming PO requirements and exceptions, confirming unit prices, and confirming receipt and accrual treatment. All source-row references are limited to the deterministic findings provided.
